name: Diabolo Menthe
description: A refreshing French café drink of bright green mint syrup topped with sparkling lemonade, beloved by schoolchildren.
ingredients: a handful of fresh chervil, chopped
a generous spoonful of lemon zest
instructions: Combine the brioche and whole milk in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the herbes de Provence and unsalted butter, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with lemon zest, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with parsley just before serving.
tips: Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more lemon zest, but you cannot take it away.
